itens.descricao: Repositorio ECR technova-api: imagens e tags publicadas pelos pipelines (conta 721003528272, us-east-1)
itens.comando: bash -c 'aws ecr describe-repositories --repository-names technova-api --query '"'"'repositories[0].[repositoryUri,imageScanningConfiguration.scanOnPush]'"'"' --output text; aws ecr describe-images --repository-name technova-api --query '"'"'sort_by(imageDetails,&imagePushedAt)[].[imagePushedAt,join(`, `,imageTags||[`<untagged>`]),imageDigest]'"'"' --output table'

itens.descricao: ECR technova-api: imagens com tag (sha-XXXXXXX por commit + latest), scan on push ativo
itens.comando: bash -c 'aws ecr describe-repositories --repository-names technova-api --query '"'"'repositories[0].[repositoryUri,imageScanningConfiguration.scanOnPush]'"'"' --output text; aws ecr describe-images --repository-name technova-api --filter tagStatus=TAGGED --query '"'"'sort_by(imageDetails,&imagePushedAt)[].[imagePushedAt,join(`,`,imageTags),imageSizeInBytes]'"'"' --output table'
